name: Cake (strawberry shortcake)
style: low-poly, colour-map texture flattened to flat colours; a whole round layer cake, pre-cut into six slices, normalised to 0.09 m tall so it is 0.21 m across

source.author: Kenney
source.note: Kenney Food Kit `cake` (plan row 194's own member). The kit's cakes: `cake` (a round two-layer cake, white top with six strawberries, a drip round the rim, pre-cut into six slices), `cake-birthday` (frosted ring with six candles and sprinkles) and `cupcake`; no single slice (`cake-slicer` is a server). `cake` chosen for a Japanese strawberry-shortcake look. Size: the source is 2.3x wider than tall; normalised by height to 0.09 m, which makes it 0.21 m across (a 21 cm cake), the dimension the plan's 0.18-0.25 m range names. Colours (noon), from a debug render: top, rim and drip (#dadae8, #f1f1f6, #ebebf2, #fafafc and the dark drip #51413d/#54443f) are cream (practical, sky shade), so the whole outside reads as whipped cream; the two pink filling bands (#e891dd) are filling (skin, one tone); the four brown sponge greys are sponge (sky, one tone: a darker shade flickered as blocks because each slice is its own mesh with its own normals); the strawberries (#e46a4f) are berry (accent, iris shade). Faint ink seams between the six slices remain (each slice has its own hull). Round, so no facing. Static, no clips.
